testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a drawing after selecting a part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:43:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a drawing after selecting a part ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings ✔ Given the Open dialog is displaying a folder containing a saved part and drawing with previews ✔ And the saved part is selected and its details are displayed ✔ And the folder contains `OpenPart.opd` and `OpenDrawingA.odd` with saved previews ✔ When the user selects the drawing ✔ Then the file name field identifies the drawing ✔ And the preview displays the drawing sheet ✔ And the Details pane identifies the drawing and displays its metadata ✔ When the user chooses Options ✔ Then the drawing options include Load in Defer Mode and Skip all unresolved files ✔ When the user cancels the Open dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes without opening the selected drawing
